    Go_intoASV

    Go_intoASV.Rd

    For each taxonomic group (or all ASVs), this function:

    • extracts ASV sequences (refseq(psIN) or rownames),

    • optionally groups ASVs by global sequence similarity (similarity_cutoff),

    • clusters intra-group sequences at clustering_cutoff to remove near-identical ASVs,

    • aligns sequences via DECIPHER::AlignSeqs or external MAFFT,

    • trims both ends by trim_nt nt to reduce V3–V4 edge noise,

    • computes pairwise distances ("simple" = Hamming; or "nucdiv" = TN93 model),

    • calculates per-sample nucleotide diversity (π), weighted by relative abundance or entropy, and optionally bootstrapped confidence intervals,

    • saves π and ASV-count matrices, and merges them into sample_data(psIN).

    Go_intoASV(
  psIN,
  project,
  level = "Genus",
  target = "all",
  method = c("simple", "nucdiv"),
  aligner = c("DECIPHER", "MAFFT"),
  min_asv = 3,
  min_abund = 10,
  clustering_cutoff = 0.995,
  similarity_cutoff = NULL,
  trim_nt = 8,
  distance_gap = c("exclude", "include"),
  distance_model = c("raw", "JC69"),
  weighting = c("abundance", "entropy"),
  compute_ci = FALSE,
  n_boot = 200,
  seed = 123,
  n_cores = 4
)

    Arguments

    psIN

    A phyloseq object containing ASV-level abundance data and optionally DNA sequences in refseq(psIN).

    project

    Character; project prefix used to create the output directory <project_YYMMDD>/table/pi_tab/.

    level

    Character; taxonomic rank to group ASVs before computing π (e.g., "Genus", "Family"). Ignored if similarity_cutoff is set. Default "Genus".

    target

    Character; a specific taxon (e.g., "Lactobacillus") or "all" to compute across all taxa. Ignored if similarity_cutoff is set. Default "all".

    method

    Character; one of c("simple","nucdiv"). "simple" uses per-position Hamming distances, while "nucdiv" applies substitution models via ape::dist.dna() (e.g., TN93).

    aligner

    Character; alignment engine, either "DECIPHER" (R-based) or "MAFFT" (external, faster if installed). Default "DECIPHER".

    min_asv

    Integer; minimum number of ASVs required to compute π. Default 3.

    min_abund

    Numeric; minimum total abundance per sample to be included. Default 10.

    clustering_cutoff

    Numeric; intra-group clustering threshold applied only within each taxon or similarity cluster to remove highly similar ASVs (e.g., 99.5\ This acts as a denoising step to prevent redundant ASVs from inflating π.

    similarity_cutoff

    Numeric or NULL. If set (e.g., 0.97), taxonomy is ignored and ASVs are globally clustered based on sequence similarity. Each resulting cluster is treated as a “species-like” group for π calculation. The output files will include the similarity tag (e.g., _similarity_0.970_) and a cluster_map_similarity_<cutoff>_<date>.csv with taxonomy annotation. When similarity_cutoff is active, clustering_cutoff is skipped.

    trim_nt

    Integer; number of nucleotides trimmed from both sequence ends to remove noisy termini of V3–V4 amplicons. Default 8.

    distance_gap

    Character; whether to "exclude" or "include" gap positions when computing nucleotide distances. Default "exclude".

    distance_model

    Character; substitution model for method="nucdiv" (e.g., "raw", "JC69"). Default "raw".

    weighting

    Character; weighting scheme for π: "abundance" (relative abundance) or "entropy" (p·(1–p)). Default "abundance".

    compute_ci

    Logical; if TRUE, compute 95\ intervals using n_boot replicates. Default FALSE.

    n_boot

    Integer; number of bootstrap replicates for confidence intervals. Default 200.

    seed

    Integer; random seed. Default 123.

    n_cores

    Integer; number of parallel cores for per-taxon computation. Default 4.

    Value

    A phyloseq object identical to the input but with new columns added to sample_data(psIN) for each computed π and ASV count. Also writes CSVs and a log file under the project directory.

    Details

    Compute within-taxon nucleotide diversity (π) from ASV-level 16S sequences in a phyloseq object, optionally trimming noisy V3–V4 termini, clustering, and bootstrapping confidence intervals (CIs). Supports both taxonomy-based and similarity-based grouping.

    Conceptual difference between cutoffs:

    • similarity_cutoff — defines global sequence-based grouping across all ASVs (taxonomy-free, analogous to ANI dereplication). Recommended for species-level clustering (e.g., 0.97).

    • clustering_cutoff — defines local denoising within each taxon or cluster to merge nearly identical ASVs (e.g., 0.995). Used only when similarity_cutoff = NULL.

    π (nucleotide diversity) per sample is computed as: $$π = 2 \sum_{i<j} w_i w_j d_{ij}$$ where \(w_i\) are normalized weights (abundance or entropy) and \(d_ij\) is pairwise sequence distance.

    When compute_ci = TRUE, 95\ bootstrap resampling of ASVs within each sample.

    The function saves:

    • pi_matrix_<method>_<level>_<target>_<date>.csv

    • asv_count_matrix_<level>_<target>_<date>.csv

    • optional pi_ci_low_matrix_*.csv, pi_ci_high_matrix_*.csv

    • text log: pi_log_<method>_<level>_<target>_<date>.txt

    • and if similarity_cutoff is set: cluster_map_similarity_<cutoff>_<date>.csv

    These are also merged into sample_data(psIN) with new columns prefixed by pi_ and asvN_.

    Author

    Heekuk Park hp2523@cumc.columbia.edu Created on 2025-11-10

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# taxonomy mode
ps_pi <- Go_intoASV(
  psIN = ps,
  project = "Gut16S",
  level = "Genus",
  target = "Lactobacillus",
  method = "nucdiv",
  aligner = "DECIPHER",
  clustering_cutoff = 0.995,
  compute_ci = TRUE,
  n_boot = 100
)

# similarity mode (taxonomy ignored)
ps_sim <- Go_intoASV(
  psIN = ps,
  project = "Gut16S",
  similarity_cutoff = 0.97,
  method = "nucdiv"
)
} # }
